extension_description.message: Send browser downloads to the zjx-download macOS app.

config_auto_capture_links_description.message: When you click a supported link, zjx-download captures it for download.

config_auto_capture_links_file_extension.message: Enter each file extension that you want to be captured then press enter

config_blacklisted_urls_description.message: Enter URLs you don't want to be captured (one per line, wildcards (*) supported)

config_silent_add_download_description.message: Automatically add captured downloads to the download list without showing the "Add Download" window

config_silent_start_download_description.message: Automatically start captured downloads without showing the "Add Download" window

config_show_popups_description.message: Show popup on selections which have links

config_native_messaging_host_description.message: When the extension intercepts a new download, it will automatically launch the app even if its not already running.

config_port_description.message: Make sure this port and the value in the app are the same otherwise this extension will not work properly

config_api_key_description.message: If you enabled API key authentication in the app settings, paste the generated API key here.

config_send_cookies_descrption.message: Note: DON'T check this if you are in a non-trusted environment

config_fallback_to_browser.message: Continue the browser download if zjx-download is unavailable

config_fallback_to_browser_description.message: When zjx-download cannot accept a captured download, keep Chrome's original download running.

connection_error_api_error.message: zjx-download could not process the request. Update the app and extension to compatible versions, then try again.

connection_error_network_error.message: Can't connect to zjx-download. Make sure the app is running and Browser Integration is enabled in its settings.

note_about_app_must_be_installed_first.message: Install and open zjx-download, then enable Browser Integration in app settings.

support_by_rating.message: Report a problem or request a feature

config_capture_file_size_limit_kb_descri.message: Only capture files with size greater than or equal to this value in kilobytes. Set 0 to capture all sizes.

config_press_a_key.message: Press a key or a combination...

config_bypass_shortcut_control_mac_warni.message: On macOS, Control + click is the secondary click, so the click never reaches the page. Pick another key.

config_bypass_shortcut_description.message: When auto-capture of download links is enabled, holding down the shortcut key and clicking on the download link uses the internal browser download method.

config_silent_add_download_description_s.message: Add captured links without asking first.

connection_status_help.message: Open zjx-download and enable Browser Integration in Settings, then check the port and API key below.

settings_group_connection_description.message: Connect the extension to the running zjx-download app.

settings_group_download_handoff_descript.message: Choose which links to capture and how zjx-download receives them.

settings_group_website_rules_description.message: Limit capture by file type, address, size, or a bypass shortcut.

settings_group_advanced_description.message: Control request headers sent with captured downloads.

connection_test_failure.message: Could not connect to zjx-download on port $port$. Check that the app is open, Browser Integration is enabled, and the API key is correct.

config_close_captured_tab.message: Close a new tab after capture

config_close_captured_tab_description.message: Close the new tab when a captured download was opened in a separate tab.
